verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Statsig's own MCP servers: a data MCP server for Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, and a Docs MCP server. Those are the server role. Nothing shows Statsig acting as an MCP client that can plug in external MCP servers and use their tools. A SaaS platform with AI features could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence it does.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
